title: The Picklock Cellar
objective: Drive out the goblin that has locked itself in the inn's cellar.

rooms.name: Cellar Stair
rooms.description: Worn steps end at a stout oak door. Someone has locked it from the far side.

rooms.name: Inn Cellar
rooms.description: A low stone cellar lit by one guttering lantern. Broken casks line the walls.

door.name: Oak Door
door.description: A stout oak door banded with iron. Its lock is the only way through.

opponents.description: A small, sharp-toothed goblin in scraps of leather, scimitar already drawn.

endings.title: The cellar is clear
endings.text: The goblin falls among the broken casks. The cellar is quiet again.

endings.title: Fallen in the cellar
endings.text: You fall to the wet stone floor. Your adventuring ends here.
